misses.prior_judgment: R6 rejected for cap-like shape, but shading was only described as flatter with fewer tube highlights.
misses.later_finding: The side/rear horizontal band and radial shell shading were not explicitly diagnosed until the user asked about lighting.
misses.lesson: Track outer silhouette, lock mid-section and light shape independently; ensure they describe compatible curvature. Existing cel-look guidance was not fully executed.
misses.counterexample: Designed highlight bands and smooth short hairstyles are not inherently defects.
misses.validation_status: Diagnosis only; no new repair or generalization result.
